newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia bond yields above lows, hit resistance.
newsitem.headline: Australia bond yields above lows, hit resistance.

text.p: *Australian bond yields crept above their initial lows as futures ran into technical resistance, but underlying sentiment remained positive in the run-up to next week's federal budget.
*U.S. Treasuries face first of refunding auctions.
Australian bond yields crept above their initial lows as futures ran into technical resistance, but underlying sentiment remained positive in the run-up to next week's federal budget.

The benchmark 10-year yield dropped below 7.70 percent and its lowest level since late February as futures continued to plough ahead in early trading before the June 10-year bond contract hit resistance 92.300.
"The market is looking for another leg-up...that may come from the jobs data, or when (Reserve Bank governor) Macfarlane faces parliament," one trader said.
